method: Every regular file in the extracted archive was opened and its leading bytes tested for the Git LFS pointer preamble ("version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/"), with a size precondition, rather than trusting the absence of a .gitattributes file.
why: The factoriolab lane established that a missing .gitattributes is not sufficient evidence of a self-contained tree. The scan is run regardless of what the scout claims.
consequence: The tree is self-contained: no LFS routing, no pointer stubs, nothing to materialise before a build. The 96-second production build that succeeded had every asset it needed on disk.
nonclaims: This checks for Git LFS pointers only. It is not a general assertion that every asset in the tree is complete or valid.
